description: Player-owned indexed work with a bounded number of callbacks per loaded tick.

capacity.description: Maximum simultaneous instances of this definition. Defaults to 128.

complete.description: Callback invoked as the player when the work completes.

count.description: Number of steps, starting at index zero.

id.description: Identity used to start or cancel this job.

index.description: Writable global integer score slot receiving the zero-based index.

per_tick.description: Maximum callbacks per instance per tick. Defaults to one.

step.description: Step callback invoked as the player.
